highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: This release rolls up everything from the 4.147.x preview line: Skia m148, variable font and color palette support, animated WebP encoding, new stream and surface APIs, and a completely reworked singleton lifecycle. It is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from v3.

breaking.title: SKPaint text/font members promoted to compile errors
breaking.body: Legacy SKPaint text and font members that were deprecated in v3 now emit compile errors. Move typeface selection and text-size configuration onto SKFont instead.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to compile errors
breaking.body: Any pre-v4 obsoleted members not already covered above now fail to compile. Check your build output and follow the migration hints in each diagnostic.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now uses an empty typeface
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty instead of resolving the platform default at draw time, so MeasureText returns 0 and nothing is drawn unless you pass an explicit typeface. Migrate: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect unset with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of == null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: SKPaint now seeds its font with SKTypeface.Default on construction and after Reset(), so paint.Typeface is never null. Code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect no typeface set will no longer fire; use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty instead.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName now returns Default (not null) for missing families on Android
breaking.body: The per-platform legacy lookup path that returned null on Android for unknown families has been replaced by a consistent font-manager lookup. FromFamilyName is now never null on any platform. Use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) if you need strict null-on-miss semantics.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException and is obsolete
breaking.body: The native offset is a 32-bit int. The long overload now uses a checked cast and is marked [Obsolete]. Large out-of-range offsets now throw instead of silently truncating. Migrate: call Move(int) with a validated in-range offset.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. On a Vulkan 1.0 instance or device the process terminates via SK_ABORT — this is not a catchable exception. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 in your VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion AND set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same value. Devices that only support Vulkan 1.0 must use the raster or another non-Ganesh backend.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice have been removed from GRVkBackendContextNative. Replace fExtensions with fVkExtensions and fFeatures with fDeviceFeatures / fDeviceFeatures2. Remove the other three assignments.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retype and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value-equality
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo). The old struct no longer implements IEquatable or equality operators. Update any == / != comparisons or Equals calls to use the new type.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter for IgnorePublicDispose has been removed. Subclasses that set this property must migrate to the constructor parameter or another lifecycle mechanism.

bullets.lead: Skia upgraded through milestones m132 → m147 → m148
bullets.detail: The bundled engine progresses from the v3 Skia pin all the way to chrome/m148, incorporating over a year of upstream rendering fixes, performance improvements, and backend updates.

bullets.lead: Variable font and color palette support
bullets.detail: SKTypeface gains variable-font axis enumeration and coordinate APIs, and a new SKFontStyleSet enables palette iteration. HarfBuzzSharp receives matching variable-font support.
A new SKWebpEncoder class supports encoding multi-frame animated WebP streams directly from SkiaSharp.
A new GetData() method returns the underlying data of a seekable stream as SKData without copying, enabling zero-copy workflows for in-memory streams.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions support for SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface
bullets.detail: DrawSurface and the surface Draw overloads now accept SKSamplingOptions, giving callers control over filtering quality when compositing surfaces.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz API completeness and HBColor struct
bullets.detail: Missing HarfBuzz API wrappers were added, naming-convention violations fixed, and a new HBColor struct properly represents hb_color_t values in managed code.
SkiaSharp now ships native assets for Linux Bionic (Android-style libc), enabling Android-NDK-linked Linux environments.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support
bullets.detail: Native Tizen builds are now produced for both x64 and arm64 architectures.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrections
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride (not Width * bytesPerPixel), and the GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y) overload was using Height instead of Width for the offset calculation — both are now fixed.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first
bullets.detail: A race condition between SKPath and its builder during GC finalization caused a native crash. The finalizer ordering is now safe.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution on Android API 36+
bullets.detail: A null-dereference on Android API 36+ when the font manager returned null for the default typeface is fixed; the fallback now yields SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: The WinUI native projection DLL was not being located correctly for .NET 9 consumers. The asset resolution is now correct.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView not rendering after tab switch in MAUI TabBar
bullets.detail: SKGLView on Android lost its rendering surface when the containing MAUI TabBar tab was switched and then restored. The surface is now recreated correctly.
Library TFMs now use versioned targets (e.g. ios26.0) and application TFMs use unversioned forms, matching the Apple platform conventions and fixing downstream build warnings.

The lifecycle of singleton instances (SKTypeface.Default, SKColorSpace.Srgb, and similar cached singletons) has been redesigned to avoid finalizer-ordering issues and to be safe across AppDomain unload and process teardown.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi constructor
bullets.detail: The runtime check that guards against loading an incompatible native library now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor instead of a module initializer, avoiding initialization-order edge cases.
Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions prior to .NET 8 are no longer produced, reducing build surface.

bullets.lead: Linux Docker builds migrated to .NET official cross-compilation images
bullets.detail: Linux native build containers now use the .NET team's official cross-compilation Docker images, ensuring consistent toolchains and faster build setup.

bullets.lead: Native dependency refreshes: expat, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, zlib, libpng, libexpat, HarfBuzz
bullets.detail: expat updated to 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, SKPath finalizer fix, SKPixmap pixel-access fixes, variable font and palette support, HarfBuzzSharp API additions, and Uno sample maintenance
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and PolySharp C# 13 support on legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.ebariche: WinUI Projection DLL resolution fix for .NET 9

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: RC 1 landed the Skia m148 engine upgrade, SKPixmap GetPixelSpan fixes, the remaining v4 obsolete promotions to compile errors, the singleton lifecycle rework, WinUI .NET 9 fix, expat 2.8.1, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, freetype 2.14.3, zlib and libpng/libexpat security updates, the HarfBuzz HBColor struct and missing API wrappers, and dropped pre-.NET 8 WASM builds.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 introduced animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), the SKPath finalizer fix, Apple platform TFM corrections, and the Uno gallery fix.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with Skia milestones m132 through m147, variable fonts and color palette APIs, SKSamplingOptions for surface drawing, Linux Bionic assets, Tizen x64/arm64 builds, and the Android tab-switch rendering fix.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 ships with this release, adding variable font axis support, a new HBColor struct, missing API wrappers, and the 14.2.0 upstream update.
